# AeroIon-Edge contract reference (v1.3)

Every field of every message, generated from `contract/schemas/`. Rules and conventions are in [message-schema.md](message-schema.md).

## `telemetry`

Periodic snapshot of one collector node. A sensor that is missing or failed reports null, never a fake 0.

- Topic: `aeroion/{node_id}/telemetry`
- Direction: node -> station
- Rate: 1 Hz
- Retained: no

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | string `^1\.[0-9]+$` |  | yes | Contract version as MAJOR.MINOR. Consumers accept any message with the same MAJOR. |
| `node_id` | string `^n[0-9]{2}$` |  | yes | Node identifier, n01 to n99. |
| `ts` | integer (1600000000000–) | ms | yes | Unix time in milliseconds, UTC. |
| `seq` | integer (0–) |  | yes | Per-node counter, +1 for every telemetry, event and wave message. Gaps mean lost messages; repeats mean duplicates. |
| `buffered` | boolean |  | no | True when the message was stored while offline and is being replayed. Omitted means false. |
| `state` | enum `state` |  | yes | Node state machine (M3). |
| `hv_on` | boolean |  | yes | High voltage actually enabled by the safety core (M3). |
| `hv_level` | number (0–1) |  | yes | Commanded HV level: 0 = off, 1 = module maximum. |
| `fog_idx_opt` | number or null (0–1) |  | yes | Fog index from the optical sensor: 0 = clear air, 1 = densest fog seen in calibration. |
| `fog_idx_virt` | number or null (0–1) |  | yes | Fog index estimated from the corona current (M5b virtual sensor). Null while HV is off. |
| `t_c` | number or null (-40–85) | °C | yes | Air temperature at the inlet. |
| `rh_pct` | number or null (0–100) | % | yes | Relative humidity at the inlet. |
| `mass_g` | number or null | g | yes | Water on the collector since the last TARE (load cell). |
| `rate_gpm` | number or null | g/min | yes | Collection rate, smoothed. |
| `i_ua` | number or null (0–) | µA | yes | Collector current (corona current reaching ground). |
| `p_w` | number or null (0–) | W | yes | Electrical power drawn by the HV module. |
| `e_wh` | number or null (0–) | Wh | yes | HV energy used since boot. With mass_g this gives grams per watt-hour. Null when no power sensor is installed. |
| `arc_risk` | number or null (0–1) |  | yes | Latest arc probability from the arc predictor (M5a). Null when the model is not running. |
| `arc_novel` | number or null (0–1) |  | no | Optional (1.3). Share of the arc predictor's last 50 windows (5 s) unlike its training data (M5a novelty guard: clipped input, current out of the trained range, unusual shape). High: arc_risk is less trustworthy, the controller (M6) stops climbing. Absent or null while the HV is off. |
| `health` | object |  | yes | Electrode health from the Townsend fit I = K·V·(V − V0) (M5c). |
| `health.onset_level` | number or null (0–1) |  | yes | Estimated corona onset V0, in hv_level units. Rising onset means fouling or wear. |
| `health.k_coef` | number or null (0–) |  | yes | Estimated Townsend coefficient K, in µA per hv_level squared. |
| `health.score` | number or null (0–1) |  | yes | 1 = like new, 0 = needs cleaning or replacement. |
| `radar_presence` | boolean or null |  | yes | Radar sees a person within the safety distance.Null when no radar is installed. |
| `lid_closed` | boolean or null |  | yes | Enclosure lid switch. Null when no lid switch is installed. |
| `batt_pct` | number or null (0–100) | % | yes | Battery charge. Null when the node runs on bench power. |

## `cmd`

Request from the station to one node (aeroion/{node_id}/cmd) or to every node (aeroion/all/cmd). The node always answers with a CMD_ACK event. A command older than ts + ttl_s is answered with result expired and ignored. Commands are requests: the safety core (M3) can still refuse.

- Topic: `aeroion/{node_id}/cmd`
- Direction: station -> node
- Rate: on demand
- Retained: no

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | string `^1\.[0-9]+$` |  | yes | Contract version as MAJOR.MINOR. Consumers accept any message with the same MAJOR. |
| `cmd_id` | string |  | yes | Unique id chosen by the sender; echoed in CMD_ACK. |
| `ts` | integer (1600000000000–) | ms | yes | Unix time in milliseconds, UTC. |
| `ttl_s` | integer (1–600) | s | yes | Time to live. The command is void after ts + ttl_s. |
| `type` | enum `cmd_type` |  | yes |  |
| `params` | object |  | yes |  |

### `params` for each command type

#### `SET_HINT`

Suggested HV level from the station optimiser, valid until the command expires.

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `params.hv_level` | number (0–1) |  | yes |  |

#### `PREARM`

Fog is coming: an ARMED node lowers its detection threshold until eta_s + 60 s.

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `params.eta_s` | number (0–3600) | s | yes | Expected fog arrival, seconds after ts. |
| `params.source_node` | string `^n[0-9]{2}$` |  | yes | Node that saw the fog first. |

#### `LOCK`

Go to LOCKED now (remote emergency stop).

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `params.reason` | string |  | yes |  |

#### `SYNC_ALLOWLIST`

Replace the node's copy of the badge list.

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `params.version` | integer (0–) |  | yes | Increases with every change. |
| `params.entries` | array of object |  | yes |  |

#### `TARE`

Zero the load cell (mass_g restarts from 0).

No params: send `{}`.

## `status`

Retained heartbeat. On connect the node registers an MQTT last will {schema_version, node_id, online: false}, which the broker publishes if the node drops. That last-will message has no ts, so ts is optional here.

- Topic: `aeroion/{node_id}/status`
- Direction: node -> station
- Rate: every 10 s, and the last will on disconnect
- Retained: yes

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | string `^1\.[0-9]+$` |  | yes | Contract version as MAJOR.MINOR. Consumers accept any message with the same MAJOR. |
| `node_id` | string `^n[0-9]{2}$` |  | yes | Node identifier, n01 to n99. |
| `online` | boolean |  | yes |  |
| `ts` | integer (1600000000000–) | ms | no | Unix time in milliseconds, UTC. |
| `uptime_s` | integer (0–) | s | no |  |
| `time_synced` | boolean |  | no | Clock synchronised with the station. The fog-front tracker ignores nodes that are not. |
| `buffered_msgs` | integer (0–) |  | no | Messages waiting in the offline buffer. |
| `rssi_dbm` | number | dBm | no | Wi-Fi signal strength. |

## `wave`

Raw collector-current window captured around an event. Debug and training data only; turn off in the final demo to save bandwidth.

- Topic: `aeroion/{node_id}/wave`
- Direction: node -> station
- Rate: on ARC, ARC_PREDICTED, manual trigger, or NOVEL (a window unlike the arc predictor's training data, at most one every 10 s)
- Retained: no

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | string `^1\.[0-9]+$` |  | yes | Contract version as MAJOR.MINOR. Consumers accept any message with the same MAJOR. |
| `node_id` | string `^n[0-9]{2}$` |  | yes | Node identifier, n01 to n99. |
| `ts` | integer (1600000000000–) | ms | yes | Time of the first sample. |
| `seq` | integer (0–) |  | yes | Per-node counter, +1 for every telemetry, event and wave message. Gaps mean lost messages; repeats mean duplicates. |
| `trigger` | enum `wave_trigger` |  | yes |  |
| `fs_hz` | integer (1–100000) | Hz | yes | Sampling frequency. |
| `unit` | always `"uA"` |  | yes | Unit of the samples (ASCII u for micro). |
| `samples` | array of number |  | yes |  |

## `front`

Fog-front estimate published by the station's network intelligence (M8) for the dashboard (M10).

- Topic: `aeroion/station/front`
- Direction: station -> dashboard
- Rate: on every new detection, and every 10 s while a front is active
- Retained: yes

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | string `^1\.[0-9]+$` |  | yes | Contract version as MAJOR.MINOR. Consumers accept any message with the same MAJOR. |
| `ts` | integer (1600000000000–) | ms | yes | Unix time in milliseconds, UTC. |
| `active` | boolean |  | yes | A fog front is currently being tracked. |
| `direction_deg` | number or null (0–360) | ° | yes | Direction the front moves toward, clockwise from north (0 = moving north, 90 = moving east). |
| `speed_mps` | number or null (0–) | m/s | yes |  |
| `fit_quality` | number or null (0–1) |  | yes | How well the detections fit a straight front: 1 = perfect. |
| `nodes_detected` | array of string `^n[0-9]{2}$` |  | yes | Nodes that have reported FOG_DETECTED for this front, in order. |
| `eta_s` | object | s | yes | Expected arrival at each node not yet reached, seconds after ts. |

## `water`

State of the station's water point (M9): water quality and its verdict, the valve, the dispensing session, the filter. The valve can open only while the verdict is ok.

- Topic: `aeroion/station/water`
- Direction: station -> dashboard
- Rate: every 5 s (every second while water flows), and at once on any change
- Retained: yes

| Field | Type | Unit | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | string `^1\.[0-9]+$` |  | yes | Contract version as MAJOR.MINOR. Consumers accept any message with the same MAJOR. |
| `ts` | integer (1600000000000–) | ms | yes | Unix time in milliseconds, UTC. |
| `quality` | object |  | yes | Water quality at the outlet and the gate's verdict. |
| `quality.verdict` | enum: `ok`, `bad`, `unknown` |  | yes | unknown: a sensor is missing or silent; the valve stays closed. |
| `quality.reason` | string |  | yes | Why, in a few words. Empty when ok. |
| `quality.tds_ppm` | number or null (0–) | ppm | yes | Total dissolved solids, compensated to 25 °C. |
| `quality.ph` | number or null (0–14) |  | yes |  |
| `quality.temp_c` | number or null (-10–80) | °C | yes | Water temperature. |
| `valve_open` | boolean |  | yes | The outlet valve is open: water is flowing to a household. |
| `session` | object or null |  | yes | The household card being served, or null. |
| `session.card` | string |  | yes | The card's label, or the end of its UID (…B2C3): never the whole UID. |
| `session.litres` | number (0–) | L | yes | Dispensed so far in this session. |
| `session.quota_left_l` | number (0–) | L | yes | What the card may still draw today, this session included. |
| `filter` | object |  | yes | The filter cartridge (identified by its NTAG213 tag). |
| `filter.tag` | string or null |  | yes | The filter's label, or the end of its tag's UID. null: no filter fitted. |
| `filter.state` | enum: `ok`, `expiring`, `expired`, `none` |  | yes | expiring: past 90 % of its capacity. expired or none: no water. |
| `filter.litres` | number or null (0–) | L | yes | Water through this filter so far. |
| `filter.capacity_l` | number or null | L | yes |  |
| `dispensed_today_l` | number (0–) | L | yes | All the water given out today (station's local day). |

## Enumerations

- `state`: `LOCKED`, `ARMED`, `HARVEST`, `BACKOFF`, `SAFE`, `MAINTENANCE` — Node state machine (M3).
- `event_type`: `FOG_DETECTED`, `FOG_CLEARED`, `ARC_PREDICTED`, `ARC`, `STATE_CHANGE`, `BADGE_TAP`, `FAULT`, `MAINT_ON`, `MAINT_OFF`, `CMD_ACK`
- `cmd_type`: `SET_HINT`, `PREARM`, `LOCK`, `SYNC_ALLOWLIST`, `TARE`
- `fault_code`: `SENSOR_FAIL`, `HV_OVERCURRENT`, `WATCHDOG`, `LID_OPEN`, `COMM_LOST`, `CLOCK_UNSYNCED`, `OTHER`
- `role`: `operator`, `technician`, `admin`, `household`, `unknown`
- `badge_action`: `arm`, `disarm`, `maint_on`, `maint_off`, `dispense`, `none`
- `badge_result`: `granted`, `denied`
- `ack_result`: `accepted`, `rejected`, `expired`
- `fog_source`: `optical`, `virtual`
- `wave_trigger`: `ARC`, `ARC_PREDICTED`, `MANUAL`, `NOVEL`

## `FOG_ALERT` (binary, node to node)

Node-to-node broadcast over ESP-NOW (demo) or LoRa (field) when a node detects fog. Packed, little-endian. Total size: 16 bytes.

| Field | C type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `magic` | `uint8_t` | Always 0xAE (174). Lets receivers ignore foreign packets. |
| `version` | `uint8_t` | Binary format version, currently 1. |
| `type` | `uint8_t` | Message type, 1 = FOG_ALERT. |
| `node_num` | `uint8_t` | Sender number: node n07 sends 7. |
| `ts_ms` | `uint64_t` | Detection time, Unix ms UTC. |
| `seq` | `uint16_t` | Sender's alert counter, wraps at 65535. |
| `fog_q` | `uint8_t` | Fog index × 255, rounded. |
| `flags` | `uint8_t` | bit 0 = clock synced, bit 1 = detected by the virtual sensor, other bits 0. |
